    AI Overview
    Target Corporation (TGT) is a major U.S. general merchandise retailer operating stores and e-commerce, with a stock trading around $116 per share as of March 2026
    . It offers a wide range of goods, including apparel, electronics, and groceries. TGT has a dividend yield of 3.90% and is known for its long history of increasing dividends. 
    Key details regarding Target (TGT): 
    • Stock Performance: The stock has seen a 5-year return of 32.67%, with a 52-week high of $126.00 and a low of $83.44.
    • Company Profile: Founded in 1902 and headquartered in Minneapolis, it functions as a discount retailer.
    • Business Segments:
      Target sells apparel, home goods, electronics, and food, with many proprietary brands.
    • Analyst Outlook: The stock has a consensus rating of "Hold," with a price target suggesting limited near-term change, notes MarketBeat.
    • Recent Activity: The company is focusing on improving performance, as mentioned in Yahoo Finance. 
    For education-related queries, TGT may also refer to a Trained Graduate Teacher.

    What is the meaning of TGT?
    Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) describes a professional who has completed a graduation (bachelor's degree) in a relevant subject along with a certification in teaching such as B. Ed (Bachelor of Education).

    Who is the R&B group TGT?
    TGT was an American supergroup that consisted of R&B singers Tyrese, Ginuwine and Tank. TGT is named after the first letter of each of the trio's stage names. The three are close friends and Tyrese was best man at Ginuwine's wedding, but TGT represented their first collaboration.

    Description

    Target Corporation, doing business as Target, is an American retail corporation headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States. Target operates retail stores. It is the eighth-largest retailer in the United States and is a component of the S&P 500 Index. Wikipedia
    CEO: Michael Fiddelke (Feb 1, 2026–)
    Headquarters: Minneapolis, MN
    Founded: 1902, Minneapolis, MN
    Number of employees: 415,000 (2026)
    Revenue: 106.6 billion USD (2024)
    Founder: George Dayton
    Subsidiaries: Shipt, Target Brands, Inc, Target Foundation · See more
